key: BENNETT: So here we are again.
en: BENNETT: So here we are again.
ja: ベネット: また、ここで会いましたね。

key: LAURA: Not every seed can bloom into a perfect flower.
en: LAURA: Not every seed can bloom into a perfect flower.
ja: ローラ: すべての種が完璧な花に咲くとは限りません。

key: BENNETT: But that's no reason not to care for each one the same.
en: BENNETT: But that's no reason not to care for each one the same.
ja: ベネット: だからといって、一つ一つを同じように大切にしない理由にはなりません。

key: Failure once does not mean failure always.
en: Failure once does not mean failure always.
ja: 一度の失敗が、常に失敗を意味するわけではありません。

key: LAURA: The seed of victory has already been planted.
en: LAURA: The seed of victory has already been planted.
ja: ローラ: 勝利の種はすでに植えられています。

key: All you need do now is nurture it to fruition!
en: All you need do now is nurture it to fruition!
ja: あとは、実を結ぶまで育てるだけです!

key: Let us test our fates against nature!
en: Let us test our fates against nature!
ja: 自然に対して、私たちの運命を試しましょう!

key: LAURA: Welcome, \PN, to my garden.
en: LAURA: Welcome, \PN, to my garden.
ja: ローラ: ようこそ、\PN、私の庭へ。

key: I believe this encounter has been a long time coming.
en: I believe this encounter has been a long time coming.
ja: この出会いは、長らく待ち望んでいたものだと思います。

key: It has been my pleasure to work alongside you for the few moments we've shared.
en: It has been my pleasure to work alongside you for the few moments we've shared.
ja: ともに過ごしたわずかな時間、あなたと共に働けたことをうれしく思っています。

key: I've heard much about your exploits.
en: I've heard much about your exploits.
ja: あなたの功績については、多くを耳にしています。

key: And I understand that you were a driving force behind waking me up when I was under Hypno's spell.
en: And I understand that you were a driving force behind waking me up when I was under Hypno's spell.
ja: そして、私がスリーパーの術にかかっていた時、目を覚まさせる原動力となったのがあなただったと理解しています。

key: For this and everything else that you've done for my sisters, you have my eternal gratitude.
en: For this and everything else that you've done for my sisters, you have my eternal gratitude.
ja: このことをはじめ、私の姉妹たちにしてくださったすべてに、永遠の感謝をささげます。

key: However, I'm afraid there is one complication, as you may be aware........
en: However, I'm afraid there is one complication, as you may be aware........
ja: ですが、恐れながら一つ厄介な事情がございまして、あなたもご存知かもしれませんが……

key: BENNETT: Well met, \PN.
en: BENNETT: Well met, \PN.
ja: ベネット: よく来たね、\PN。

key: LAURA: This was the compromise we reached.
en: LAURA: This was the compromise we reached.
ja: ローラ: これが私たちの至った妥協案です。

key: BENNETT: I think you know by now that Reborn's Elite 4 are dual-typed anyway.
en: BENNETT: I think you know by now that Reborn's Elite 4 are dual-typed anyway.
ja: ベネット: リボーンの四天王はどのみち2タイプ制だと、もう知ってると思うけど。

key: After discussing the issue with the folks down at the Grand Hall, they determined there was no harm in splitting those two types between two people.
en: After discussing the issue with the folks down at the Grand Hall, they determined there was no harm in splitting those two types between two people.
ja: グランドホールの人たちと話し合った結果、その2タイプを二人で分けても問題ないと判断されたんだ。

key: As long as we stick to the six Pokémon limit, it's effectively a typical match.
en: As long as we stick to the six Pokémon limit, it's effectively a typical match.
ja: 6匹制限さえ守れば、実質的には通常の試合と変わらない。

key: LAURA: I am aware that Bennett has a somewhat colored history, but I ask that you treat us as one and the same.
en: LAURA: I am aware that Bennett has a somewhat colored history, but I ask that you treat us as one and the same.
ja: ローラ: ベネットには少々複雑な過去があると承知していますが、私たちを一つのものとして扱っていただければと思います。

key: I do not believe that one's condition in the past should determine their treatment in the present.
en: I do not believe that one's condition in the past should determine their treatment in the present.
ja: 過去の状況が、現在の扱いを決定づけるべきだとは思いません。

key: I would not be so well-off if that were the case either........
en: I would not be so well-off if that were the case either........
ja: もしそうだとしたら、私もこうして恵まれた立場にはいられなかったでしょうから……

key: And damage done to any flower is erased each spring when a new one blooms.
en: And damage done to any flower is erased each spring when a new one blooms.
ja: そして、花にどんな傷がついても、毎年春に新しい花が咲けば、それは消えていくものです。

key: BENNETT: Adaptation to the circumstances is a necessary trait for any organism.
en: BENNETT: Adaptation to the circumstances is a necessary trait for any organism.
ja: ベネット: 状況に適応する能力は、あらゆる生物に必要な特性だよ。

key: LAURA: And nature possesses beauty exactly because it is ever-changing.
en: LAURA: And nature possesses beauty exactly because it is ever-changing.
ja: ローラ: そして自然が美しいのは、まさに絶えず変化し続けているからです。

key: BENNETT: Those who do not change inevitably fall behind in the world.
en: BENNETT: Those who do not change inevitably fall behind in the world.
ja: ベネット: 変わらない者は、必ず世界に取り残されていく。

key: I have no intention of falling behind and I hope, \PN, that you do not either.
en: I have no intention of falling behind and I hope, \PN, that you do not either.
ja: 僕は取り残されるつもりはないし、\PN、君もそうでないことを願うよ。

key: Laura and I will endeavor as partners to adapt to each other's battling style.
en: Laura and I will endeavor as partners to adapt to each other's battling style.
ja: ローラと僕は、パートナーとしてお互いのバトルスタイルに適応するよう努めるつもりだ。

key: Show us, \PN, how you've adapted to your conditions!
en: Show us, \PN, how you've adapted to your conditions!
ja: \PN、君がどう自分の状況に適応してきたか、見せてくれ!

key: BENNETT: Impressive. I'll make note to study this later.
en: BENNETT: Impressive. I'll make note to study this later.
ja: ベネット: 見事だ。後で研究のためにメモしておこう。

key: BENNETT: \PN, do you know what "Apolysis" is?
en: BENNETT: \PN, do you know what "Apolysis" is?
ja: ベネット: \PN、『アポリシス』って何か知ってる?

key: BENNETT: Impressive!
en: BENNETT: Impressive!
ja: ベネット: 見事だ!

key: Then you may already understand how well you're growing.
en: Then you may already understand how well you're growing.
ja: なら、自分がどれだけ成長してるか、もうわかってるのかもしれないね。

key: BENNETT: That's only understandable.
en: BENNETT: That's only understandable.
ja: ベネット: それも無理はないか。

key: Apolysis is the process by which a larval--
en: Apolysis is the process by which a larval--
ja: アポリシスっていうのは、幼虫が――

key: Ah, well...
en: Ah, well...
ja: ああ、まあ…

key: In short, it means you're growing too.
en: In short, it means you're growing too.
ja: 要するに、君も成長してるってことだよ。

key: I look forward to seeing just what heights you can reach.
en: I look forward to seeing just what heights you can reach.
ja: 君がどこまで高みに達するか、楽しみにしてる。

key: BENNETT: Amazing as always, \PN.
en: BENNETT: Amazing as always, \PN.
ja: ベネット: 相変わらずすごいね、\PN。

key: I'll continue to study more as well.
en: I'll continue to study more as well.
ja: 僕もさらに研究を続けるよ。

key: LAURA: Butterflies and buttercups are not so terribly different.
en: LAURA: Butterflies and buttercups are not so terribly different.
ja: ローラ: チョウとキンポウゲは、それほど大きくは違いません。

key: Everyone must find beauty in their own struggle to grow.
en: Everyone must find beauty in their own struggle to grow.
ja: 誰もが、自分自身の成長への苦闘の中に美を見出さなければなりません。

key: I hope you do not miss the beauty in yours.
en: I hope you do not miss the beauty in yours.
ja: あなたが、ご自身の中にある美しさを見逃さないことを願っています。

key: BENNETT: One more thing before you go, \PN.
en: BENNETT: One more thing before you go, \PN.
ja: ベネット: 行く前に、もう一つだけ、\PN。

key: BENNETT: I owe you this.
en: BENNETT: I owe you this.
ja: ベネット: これは君に返すべきものだ。

key: It should not have left your care in the first place.
en: It should not have left your care in the first place.
ja: そもそも、君の手を離れるべきではなかったんだ。

key: LAURA: And mine as well.
en: LAURA: And mine as well.
ja: ローラ: 私からもです。

key: One half of the pair will hardly do you well.
en: One half of the pair will hardly do you well.
ja: 対のうち片方だけでは、あなたのお役にはあまり立たないでしょう。

key: It is better in your hands for the purpose it was meant, than in mine as a simple memento.
en: It is better in your hands for the purpose it was meant, than in mine as a simple memento.
ja: 私の手元でただの記念品としてあるより、本来の目的のためにあなたの手にある方がよいはずです。

key: BENNETT: No more time to waste though.
en: BENNETT: No more time to waste though.
ja: ベネット: とはいえ、もう無駄にできる時間はない。

key: Your path is forward still.
en: Your path is forward still.
ja: 君の道は、まだ前にある。

key: LAURA: Perhaps I will make a new arrangement for next time...
en: LAURA: Perhaps I will make a new arrangement for next time...
ja: ローラ: 次回までに、新しい生け花を用意しておきましょうか…

key: But then, this is such an easy place to decorate.
en: But then, this is such an easy place to decorate.
ja: とはいえ、ここは飾り付けやすい場所です。

key: After all, it's near impossible to count wisteria even if one tries.
en: After all, it's near impossible to count wisteria even if one tries.
ja: 何しろ、藤の花は数えようとしても、ほとんど不可能ですから。

key: There is as much freedom in that as there is in the future.
en: There is as much freedom in that as there is in the future.
ja: そこには、未来にあるのと同じだけの自由があります。

key: BENNETT: You have my utmost support, \PN.
en: BENNETT: You have my utmost support, \PN.
ja: ベネット: 全面的に応援してるよ、\PN。

key: I have just one request:
en: I have just one request:
ja: 一つだけお願いがある:

key: Give the next trainer a solid thrashing from me as well.
en: Give the next trainer a solid thrashing from me as well.
ja: 次のトレーナーにも、僕の分までしっかり打ちのめしておいてくれ。

key: LAURA: Welcome again, \PN.
en: LAURA: Welcome again, \PN.
ja: ローラ: またようこそ、\PN。

key: Would you like to introduce our guest?
en: Would you like to introduce our guest?
ja: こちらのお客様をご紹介いただけますか?

key: FLORA: I can introduce myself just fine.
en: FLORA: I can introduce myself just fine.
ja: フローラ: 自己紹介くらい自分でできるけど。

key: Flora Grevillea. It's a privilege.
en: Flora Grevillea. It's a privilege.
ja: フローラ・グレヴィレア。光栄だわ。

key: Yours, specifically.
en: Yours, specifically.
ja: 特に、あんたの方がね。

key: LAURA: I am always honored to have more visitors here.
en: LAURA: I am always honored to have more visitors here.
ja: ローラ: ここに新たな訪問者をお迎えできるのは、いつも光栄です。

key: Bennett won't be joining us this time.
en: Bennett won't be joining us this time.
ja: 今回はベネットは同席しません。

key: It is my hope that you both will still find me to be an acceptable challenge alone.
en: It is my hope that you both will still find me to be an acceptable challenge alone.
ja: 私一人でも、お二人にとって受け入れられる挑戦であることを願っています。

key: FLORA: "Acceptable"?
en: FLORA: "Acceptable"?
ja: フローラ: 『受け入れられる』?

key: Aren't you supposed to be one of the best?
en: Aren't you supposed to be one of the best?
ja: 最強の一人ってことになってるんじゃないの?

key: Or are you as worthless as that last girl?
en: Or are you as worthless as that last girl?
ja: それとも、さっきの子と同じくらい役立たず?

key: LAURA: Heather has been through a lot in a short period of time.
en: LAURA: Heather has been through a lot in a short period of time.
ja: ローラ: ヘザーは短い間にたくさんのことを経験してきました。

key: Well, perhaps all of us have.
en: Well, perhaps all of us have.
ja: まあ、おそらく私たち全員がそうなのでしょう。

key: Even so, she earned and defended a place here despite her age.
en: Even so, she earned and defended a place here despite her age.
ja: それでも、彼女はその年齢にもかかわらず、この場所を勝ち取り、守り続けています。

key: For my part, it isn't that I particularly lack confidence in my abilities.
en: For my part, it isn't that I particularly lack confidence in my abilities.
ja: 私自身に関して言えば、自分の実力に特に自信がないわけではありません。

key: Rather, I would not want to insult you by disrespecting yours.
en: Rather, I would not want to insult you by disrespecting yours.
ja: むしろ、あなたの実力を軽んじて侮辱するようなことはしたくないのです。

key: \PN is our champion, and I'm sure you, too, have worked hard in your own way to reach this point.
en: \PN is our champion, and I'm sure you, too, have worked hard in your own way to reach this point.
ja: \PNは私たちのチャンピオンです。あなたもまた、ご自身なりに努力してここまで来られたのでしょう。

key: I look forward to seeing the strength that brought you here.
en: I look forward to seeing the strength that brought you here.
ja: あなたをここまで導いた強さを、拝見するのを楽しみにしています。

key: FLORA: ...Tch.
en: FLORA: ...Tch.
ja: フローラ: …チッ。

key: That's not a fun answer at all.
en: That's not a fun answer at all.
ja: 全然面白くない答えね。

key: But fine. Let's see what you've got!
en: But fine. Let's see what you've got!
ja: でもいいわ。見せてもらいましょうか!

key: FLORA: ...\PN.
en: FLORA: ...\PN.
ja: フローラ: …\PN。

key: How did you come all the way here and not even bring a full team to fight with?
en: How did you come all the way here and not even bring a full team to fight with?
ja: ここまで来といて、フルパーティすら連れてきてないってどういうこと?

key: Do you WANT me to lose?
en: Do you WANT me to lose?
ja: あたしに負けてほしいわけ?

key: (Seriously, how did this moron ever get to be champion...)
en: (Seriously, how did this moron ever get to be champion...)
ja: (マジで、この馬鹿がどうやってチャンピオンになったわけ…)

key: Go back and get some actual goddamn Pokémon before I lose my fucking patience already!
en: Go back and get some actual goddamn Pokémon before I lose my fucking patience already!
ja: 戻ってちゃんとポケモン連れてきなさいよ、あたしの我慢が切れる前にね!

key: FLORA: Hey, \PN?
en: FLORA: Hey, \PN?
ja: フローラ: ねえ、\PN?

key: What are you doing?
en: What are you doing?
ja: 何やってるの?

key: Did you perhaps somehow manage to forget that you need to PICK SOME POKÉMON?!
en: Did you perhaps somehow manage to forget that you need to PICK SOME POKÉMON?!
ja: もしかして、ポケモンを選ぶ必要があるのを忘れちゃったとか?!

key: This has been a genuine treat!
en: This has been a genuine treat!
ja: 本当に　素敵なひとときでした!

key: FLORA: Free. Even with this jacked up arena.
en: FLORA: Free. Even with this jacked up arena.
ja: フローラ: 無傷。このめちゃくちゃな会場でもね。

key: LAURA: I don't know that I would particularly estimate the battle as having been "free", but........
en: LAURA: I don't know that I would particularly estimate the battle as having been "free", but........
ja: ローラ: このバトルを特に「無傷」と評価できるかはわかりませんが……

key: LAURA: If your victory can be a point of pride for you, then that's more than enough for me.
en: LAURA: If your victory can be a point of pride for you, then that's more than enough for me.
ja: ローラ: あなたの勝利があなたの誇りになるのなら、私にはそれで十分です。

key: FLORA: ...Whatever.
en: FLORA: ...Whatever.
ja: フローラ: …別に。

key: You put up a decent fight, I guess.
en: You put up a decent fight, I guess.
ja: まあまあの戦いはしてくれたわね。

key: (And it is nice to see someone with Grass Types in a high position...)
en: (And it is nice to see someone with Grass Types in a high position...)
ja: （草タイプ使いが偉い立場にいるのを見るのは、悪くないわね……）

key: (Maybe not EVERYONE here is worthless.)
en: (Maybe not EVERYONE here is worthless.)
ja: （もしかしたら、ここの全員がクズってわけでもないのかも）

key: But you are seriously WAY too nice for your own good.
en: But you are seriously WAY too nice for your own good.
ja: でもあんた、マジで自分のためにならないくらいお人好しすぎるわね。

key: LAURA: I........ do hear that from time to time.
en: LAURA: I........ do hear that from time to time.
ja: ローラ: …………それは、時々言われますね。

key: I don't suppose you've met my younger sister, have you?
en: I don't suppose you've met my younger sister, have you?
ja: もしかして、私の妹に会ったことはありませんか?

key: I believe the two of you might get along very well.
en: I believe the two of you might get along very well.
ja: あなたたち二人はとても気が合うと思うのですが。

key: Possibly dangerously well........
en: Possibly dangerously well........
ja: もしかしたら、危険なくらいに……

key: ........Perhaps it is for the best that you do not meet.
en: ........Perhaps it is for the best that you do not meet.
ja: ………おそらく、会わない方がよいのかもしれません。

key: FLORA: I'll put it on my bucket list.
en: FLORA: I'll put it on my bucket list.
ja: フローラ: バケットリストに入れとくわ。

key: I'm going ahead.
en: I'm going ahead.
ja: 先に行くわね。

key: LAURA: She seems to be of a similar type of girl to my own sisters.
en: LAURA: She seems to be of a similar type of girl to my own sisters.
ja: ローラ: 彼女は私の姉妹たちとよく似たタイプの女性のようですね。

key: I think all of them would be much benefitted by setting down their respective objectives, and learning to enjoy a moment of tranquility among the flowers.
en: I think all of them would be much benefitted by setting down their respective objectives, and learning to enjoy a moment of tranquility among the flowers.
ja: 彼女たちも皆、目標をひとまず置いて、花々の中で静けさのひとときを楽しむことを学べば、きっとためになると思うのですが。

key: I don't know her that well, but is it too naive to hope that, perhaps knowing that is why she uses Grass Types herself?
en: I don't know her that well, but is it too naive to hope that, perhaps knowing that is why she uses Grass Types herself?
ja: 彼女のことをよく知りませんが、もしかして、そのことを知っているからこそ、彼女自身も草タイプを使うのではないかと望むのは、あまりに単純すぎるでしょうか。

key: It really is good to see you back here once more.
en: It really is good to see you back here once more.
ja: またここに戻って来てくださって、本当にうれしいです。

key: Did you see how well the flowers in my garden have been growing recently?
en: Did you see how well the flowers in my garden have been growing recently?
ja: 最近、私の庭の花々がとてもよく育っているのに、お気づきになりましたか?

key: In moments like these, I'm grateful to have someone else here to witness their beauty, too.
en: In moments like these, I'm grateful to have someone else here to witness their beauty, too.
ja: こういう瞬間には、その美しさを一緒に見てくれる人がいることに感謝します。

key: Shall we enjoy a moment to admire them together?
en: Shall we enjoy a moment to admire them together?
ja: 一緒に、少し眺める時間を楽しみましょうか?

key: Wonderful as always.
en: Wonderful as always.
ja: いつもながら　すばらしいですね

key: LAURA: Any moment shared with you is one to be cherished.
en: LAURA: Any moment shared with you is one to be cherished.
ja: ローラ: あなたと過ごすどんな瞬間も、大切にすべきものです。

key: I hope that the rest of your moments today are just as beautiful.
en: I hope that the rest of your moments today are just as beautiful.
ja: 今日の残りの時間も、同じくらい美しいものであることを願っています。

key: You're always welcome in my garden whenever you please.
en: You're always welcome in my garden whenever you please.
ja: 私の庭には、いつでもお好きな時にお越しください。

key: LAURA: I hope that the rest of your moments today are just as beautiful.
en: LAURA: I hope that the rest of your moments today are just as beautiful.
ja: ローラ: 今日の残りの時間も、同じくらい美しいものであることを願っています。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
